property_summary: After Alice deposits 1 wei, then Bob deposits 1 wei, calling withdrawBalance() on Alice reverts in the bug (preventing the balance from being zeroed) but succeeds in the reference, so that userBalance[Alice] is 0 in the reference but 1 in the bug.
change_summary: Change the external call to revert() instead of checking success in the if statement; always revert, so the balance is never zeroed.
